column5: evidence
(file, line, message, ...) handler called by ~5,700 asserts: singleton checks, DLReadWriteLock.cpp, PthreadMutex.cpp, DLTemporaryHeap.cpp, container heap checks; does not return
rank 1, 4,057 callers: given a pointer, checks the thread's temporary heap range, then searches the heap list under the read/write lock (DLReadWriteLock.cpp asserts), else returns Heap_GetDefault()
rank 2, 3,827 callers: lazily constructs the default heap under the global init mutex and returns it
rank 3, 2,744 callers: returns the byte at +0x10 of a mutex object, the flag set after PthreadMutex_InitRecursive succeeds
rank 4: scePthreadMutexattrSettype(attr, 2 = recursive) + scePthreadMutexInit; asserts from PthreadMutex.cpp
rank 5, 2,672 callers: lazily constructs a 0x440-byte global; Heap_FindForPointer uses its heap list (+0x468) and lock (+0x470), containers its allocator (+0x458)
rank 6: lazily initializes and returns the static mutex that Heap_GetDefault and MemorySystem_Get lock
rank 8: sets vtable 057b3ba0, binds g_ContainerHeap, asserts "Tried to create container with incompatible heap."
rank 13: resets vtable 057b3ba0 and frees each element through the bound heap
rank 14: (size, alignment, heap) -> heap->vtable[0x58](heap, size, alignment); callers construct objects in the result (e.g. 0xB0 bytes aligned 16)
rank 15: allocates the calling thread's temporary heap (default 0x20000) into TLS; asserts from DLTemporaryHeap.cpp
rank 32: TemporaryHeap_EnsureForThread() then returns the thread's temporary heap + 0x28
rank 34: LOCK dec of an int, returns the old value
rank 17: atomic decrement of the count at +8; at zero calls vtable[1] (destroy)
rank 39: non-atomic version of RefCounted_ReleaseAtomic
rank 12: grows an array whose capacity word uses mask 0x3FFFFFFF and a 'don't deallocate' top bit (hkArray layout), via allocator vtable +0x20/+0x30
rank 11: as hkArrayUtil::_reserve, with the new capacity = max(1, 2 * size)
rank 9: release of a GC-tracked object whose count is the low 22 bits of a flags word (Scaleform AS3 RefCountBaseGC layout); lives with Scaleform AS3 code ("Error #{0}")
rank 10: switch on a 5-bit kind tag, decrementing the referenced object's count (kinds 10-14) and calling SF_AS3_RefCountGC_Release
rank 18: printf-style formatter into a string object; asserts "format() can not handle oneself as a format string."
rank 31: Dinkumware basic_string<wchar_t>::assign(ptr, count): inline buffer of 8 at +8, length +0x18, capacity +0x20, handles a source inside its own buffer
rank 19: second instantiation of WString_Assign (identical 477-byte body, different allocator type)

reads HolygrailExParam variationNum (+5), uniqueBaseFlagId (+0xc) and uniqueItemNN_head/tail (offset tables 04b359c0/04b35a40): rolls rng % variationNum, then, if any unique item's flag is unset, picks one such item's range by weight (range size) and a variation inside it; also rolls the fixedSf/freeSf/groupSf sub-feature lots
parses a dungeon record of version 4 (0x7c bytes) or 5 (0x8c, adds the name): 64-bit id, 32-bit packed map id, HolygrailExParam row (via 0231f720), 18 dwords of sub-feature picks, 16 bytes, name
dungeonNameBaseId (HolygrailExParam +8) plus each picked DungeonFeatureParam's dungeonNameModifierId (+0x1c), ordered by dungeonNamePriority (+6)
binary search of the SoloParamRepository table at +0xf10/+0xf18 by row id; its rows are read at HolygrailExParam offsets (variationNum +5, dungeonNameBaseId +8)
as Param_GetHolygrailEx for the table at +0xf58/+0xf60; read at DungeonFeatureParam offsets (+6, +0x1c)
looks up a sub-feature lot row whose float weights at +0x14..+0x38 are DungeonSubFeatLotParam rate_1..10
packed map id {area, block, sub, variant}: for area 0x1d (m29) returns the HolygrailExParam row 6000 + block*10 + sub/10, else area*1000000 + block*10000 + sub*100 + variant

menu item 0 picks any HolygrailExParam row and calls ChaliceRitual_PickDungeon; item 400 sets the variation directly; items 300-312 toggle and choose sub-feature picks
writes the 4 bytes of a packed map id into 8-bit flag groups at 94000096 + slot*100000
constructs the 0x1780-byte global at 05956678; seeds the SFMT-19937 generator at +0x70 from gettimeofday (init multiplier 0x6c078965, 624 words, parity word 0x13c9e684)
binary search of the SoloParamRepository table at +0x970/+0x978 (param index 32, CalcCorrectGraph in the name table at 05755ad0) by row id

reads a CalcCorrectGraph row: finds the stage stageMaxVal[i] < x <= stageMaxVal[i+1], ratio r, exponent adjPt_maxGrowVal[i]; e >= 0: g[i] + (g[i+1]-g[i]) r^e, else g[i] + (g[i+1]-g[i]) (1 - (1-r)^-e); clamped to the stage
sums, per level from the current one, x^2 (max(0, x - boundry_value) boundry_inclination_soul + init_inclination_soul) + adjustment_value with x = level + 81 (CalcCorrectGraph row 200), each rounded
the same per-level cost, checked against a held amount and a stat cap of 99

weapon base (EquipParamWeapon +0xc4..) x upgrade rate x the move's atkPhysCorrection.. x stat factors 1 + correct/100 x curve(stat)/100 (Str+Skl added for physical, Bloodtinge alone in mode 4, Arcane for arcane/fire/bolt), requirement penalty, (100 + throwAtkRate)/100 in a throw
four weighted sums (all weights 1.0) of the six stats at +0x40,+0x48,+0x58,+0x60,+0x68,+0x70; fed to CalcCorrectGraph row 102 by the defense functions
CalcCorrectGraph 102 of the stat sum, rounded, plus four armor pieces (0197a810), times and plus effect values (01be76b0), for four defense types

fills an outgoing hit record from the attack context: attack values (+0x10..0x16), damage type, the AtkParam row's flags, and the regain amount at +0x16c = wepRegainHp (EquipParamWeapon +0x138) x wepRegainHpScale (AtkParam +0x98) x 0.01 + atkRegainHp (+0x9a), with regainableSlotId (+0x13f), regainableHpRateScale (+0x164) and regainableTimeScale (+0x168)

per frame: on damage the grace HP is the HP before the hit less damage x (1 - DelayRate) and the timer is DelayTime; pending regain x RegainRate (at least 1) is added to HP up to the grace HP, rounded down; after the timer, the grace HP drains at max HP x VanishDelayRate per second down to HP

CalcCorrectGraph row 101 of the second stat (+0x48); what it sets is not followed

per damage type, r = attack / defense: reduction 90 at r <= 0.12, 90 - 38.74 (r - 0.12)^2 below 1, 30 + 13.333 (r - 2.5)^2 to 2.5, 10 + 0.6612 (r - 8)^2 to 8, 10 above (and with no defense); damage = attack x (1 - reduction/100); then caller multipliers, the sum, x 1.4 / 1.125 / 0.8 by flags, x a final factor (constants 04d26854..94)
NpcParam def_phys x (100 + def_slash/def_blow/def_thrust by the attack's type 1/2/3) / 100, def_mag, def_fire, def_thunder, each x effect multiplier + effect addition (01be76b0)
